title: Ares Ascension v2
author: Johnny W.
desc:
Ares Ascension v2 is a 14-week athletic hypertrophy program for lifters who refuse to choose between strength, athleticism, and physique. Combining Olympic weightlifting, Jim Wendler’s proven 5/3/1 methodology, and evidence-based hypertrophy, it develops explosive power, functional strength, and a stage-worthy physique.

Built upon the philosophy of Athletic Hypertrophy, Ares Ascension pursues a physique earned through strength, power, and athletic performance. Every exercise is selected with purpose, prioritizing movements that build real-world capability and balanced muscular development rather than chasing fatigue or unnecessary volume. The result is a body that performs as impressively as it looks.

Unlike traditional bodybuilding or powerlifting programs, Ares Ascension develops explosive power, functional strength, and balanced muscularity simultaneously. The emphasis is on broad shoulders, a wide back, powerful traps, well-developed arms, and an athletic V-taper while maintaining proficiency in the Snatch, Clean & Jerk, and Deadlift.

The program is built around three training priorities:

Olympic Lifting

* Percentage-based progressions improve technique, speed, and explosive power in the Snatch and Clean & Jerk.

Strength Development

* Deadlift, Front Squat, and Incline Bench Press follow Jim Wendler’s 5/3/1 system for sustainable long-term strength.

Athletic Hypertrophy

* High-frequency training prioritizes delts, lats, upper chest, traps, and arms. Weekly volume is strategically distributed to maximize muscle growth while supporting recovery and performance.

Training five days per week, each workout is designed to be completed in approximately 60-75 minutes. Assistance work follows modern recovery principles, allowing muscles to be trained multiple times each week while minimizing unnecessary fatigue.

The program consists of two six-week progression blocks separated by deload weeks (Weeks 7 and 14). Each block contains two consecutive 5/3/1 waves. After every three-week wave, increase lower-body Training Maxes by 10 lb and upper-body Training Maxes by 5 lb, for projected increases of 30 lb and 15 lb, respectively, by the program’s completion.

Designed for intermediate and advanced lifters, Ares Ascension develops athletes who look as capable as they are strong.

Mission: Build the strength of a lifter, the power of an Olympian, and the physique of a Greek Titan.
